capabilities: Create chapters, scenes, characters, locations and other story objects as Markdown notes
Show manuscript, planning and word target in one writing overview
Adopt existing notes into a project while keeping text, properties and path
Export and import project files in the Writeller Exchange format with a preview
Clean up references when an object is deleted and restore interrupted deletions
extras: Preview release 0.3.7; requires Obsidian 1.14.5 or newer; mobile-device testing still pending; interface in German and English; no network, tracking or AI calls; legacy *.writeller.json archives are incompatible; detailed handbook, FAQ and changelog live outside the README.
problem: Novel material scattered across loose notes has no single overview tying chapters, scenes, characters and places together, and no way to hand that structure to a dedicated writing app.

relations.evidence: enabling manual project exchange between Writeller and this Obsidian plugin

summary: Writing-project planner that organizes chapters, scenes, characters and places as ordinary Markdown notes and exchanges projects with Writeller.
